titles.title: Job titles or keywords
titles.description: Each term is searched in each location.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, regions or countries. An empty list searches without a location filter.

rows.title: Jobs per search
rows.description: Limit unique delivered jobs for each title/location pair. Zero continues until the page limit, global limit or end of results.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs for the whole run
maxItems.description: A shared limit across every search and pasted URL. Defaults to 100 to bound a first run.

publishedAt.title: Date posted
publishedAt.description: Restrict jobs by the time they were published.

industry.title: Industry codes
industry.description: Numeric LinkedIn industry codes, passed as f_I. You can also paste a LinkedIn search URL with its industry filters.

companyId.title: Company IDs
companyId.description: Numeric LinkedIn company IDs; the filter is sent to LinkedIn.

companyUrls.title: Company URLs to filter a search
companyUrls.description: Public company pages resolved to company IDs. Resolution failures stop the run instead of silently removing the company filter.

companyName.title: Company names to keep
companyName.description: Exact, case-insensitive company names checked on returned listings. Use IDs for filtering on LinkedIn's side.

easyApply.title: Easy Apply filter
easyApply.description: Send LinkedIn's Easy Apply search filter.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Request relevant jobs or the most recently posted jobs first.

startUrls.title: Or paste LinkedIn URLs
startUrls.description: Search URLs, individual job URLs or company page URLs. When present, these define the searches and structured filters are ignored.

maxRowsPerUrl.title: Jobs per pasted URL
maxRowsPerUrl.description: Per-URL result limit. Zero uses the public search ceiling of 1,000; maxItems still caps the whole run.

companyProfile.title: Add public company profiles
companyProfile.description: Fetch each company page once per process to add website, industry, size and other published profile information. Blocked profiles are marked failed.

enrichCompany.title: Add public recruiter and job signals
enrichCompany.description: Include recruiter headline/photo and structured job signals when present in the public response. Unavailable values remain null.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per search
maxPages.description: Stop each search after this many listing pages.

requestDelayMillis.title: Delay between requests (milliseconds)
requestDelayMillis.description: A shared minimum interval for requests. Increase it if LinkedIn rate-limits your connection.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: Bounded retries with increasing wait times. Missing or removed pages are not retried.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional locally; enable Apify Proxy for cloud runs. Residential proxies can help with rate limits and company pages.
